about: One-frame event of esv::encumbrance::StateSystem (per-frame update bg3.exe+0x31D8430): put on a character whose encumbrance state changed, holding the old and the new state (0..3, compared against eoc::encumbrance::StatsComponent's three weight thresholds). Never seen alive. Registry total 8 on both rows. The savemodel tool matched an unrelated model (game.camp.v0.SuppliesSelectionStateChangedEventOneFrameComponent) by substring: this one is not saved.

evidence.says: Creator bg3.exe+0x31D9B10: AllocRaw(8), writes 0 as one 64-bit value. Update bg3.exe+0x31D8430 lines 530-574: reads the current state (the same 4 bytes the code then overwrites with the new state - eoc::encumbrance::StateComponent.State, uint32 in SE Stats.h); when it differs from the new state, it creates the component on the entity and writes the old state as a 32-bit value at +0 and the new state as a 32-bit value at +4.

Same function: new state = 0..3 from testing whether the weight is greater than the first, second and third threshold of the stats (eoc::encumbrance::StatsComponent UnencumberedWeight, EncumberedWeight, HeavilyEncumberedWeight; stride 0xC) and 0 when a flag is off; written as the 32-bit value at +4.
